criteria.criterion: `upstream_branch_refs` selects remote-tracking refs by excluding the configured ticket event-log branch rather than by matching the local branch name, so the result no longer depends on local and remote branch names agreeing.
A new test fixes the fixture on one branch name and the remote commit on another, and asserts the close succeeds; it fails on baseline and passes after the change.
`pytest tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_completion_gate.py -k test_file_impact_close_fetches_before_rejecting_stale_clone` passes, having been verified failing on baseline `main` first.
A unit test asserts `upstream_branch_refs` omits `refs/remotes/<remote>/tickets` when that ref exists, so the ticket event log is still never walked as code history.

`pytest tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_completion_gate.py -k test_file_impact_close_distinguishes_refreshed_absence` still passes, proving the gate continues to refuse a clone where the work genuinely has not landed upstream.
